subject: [NAME] - fraud models
text:
Hi [NAME],

Noticed Hypergerve shares the IDV leaderboard w/ our customer Entrust
(Onfido) - curious if some of the data quality challenges we're solving for
them resonate with you.

We help them improve facial recognition and IDV model accuracy by
tightening the loop between model predictions, labeling, and retraining
(model-assisted pre-labeling -> HITL review -> active learning). The
result: better performance, fewer false positives, and audit-safe handling
of PII.

How are you approaching this at Hypergerve? Happy to swap notes - I'm
flexible Tue - Thu if you're open to chat.

agentic workflows, improving training data quality, preference ranking,

about agent reliability and iteration. Happy to keep it informal - does
Thursday / Friday work for you?
